user.title: Add a GWM vehicle
user.description:
Enter the 4 values captured from the Great Wall Motor app (version 2.1.3).

How to get them: capture the `GW.M.APP_LOGIN` request (e.g. with Reqable / HttpCanary) and read `ssoid`, `phone` and `ssoTk` from the `p` query parameter. `vin` can be found in the vehicle list response.

Note: the tokenId is single-session. After Home Assistant logs in, the phone app's vehicle session is kicked and it may ask you to log in again.

data_description.sso_id: The ssoid from GW.M.APP_LOGIN, e.g. U770000000000000000
data_description.sso_token: The ssoTk from GW.M.APP_LOGIN, a 32-char hex string
data_description.vin: 17-char VIN, from the vehicle list response
data_description.model: Not returned by the API - fill in if you want, e.g. Haval H6 Champion Edition
data_description.license_plate: Not returned by the API - fill in if you want

reauth_confirm.title: Credentials expired
reauth_confirm.description:
The ssoTk for vehicle {vin} ({phone}) has expired.

Capture a new ssoTk and paste it below. Other settings are kept.

error.invalid_auth: ssoTk is invalid or expired, please capture a new one
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the GWM server, please try again
error.invalid_vin: Invalid VIN, or this vehicle is not bound to the account

init.title: GWM options
init.description:
Data is uploaded by the car itself, so a shorter interval does not make it fresher. 5-10 minutes is recommended. If you need it now, press 'Refresh data' in the diagnostics section of the device page.

Model and licence plate only affect device info; leave them empty if unsure.

refresh.name: Refresh data (ask the car to report)
